## Decisions

- The EN ISBN (9780316260190) is listed identically for both "The First Door" and "Darkness Within" on Wikipedia's table -- confirmed real, not a table error: Yen Press's 2015 EN release is a single omnibus of both JP novels, same ISBN because it's the same physical book. French edition has no ISBN given by Wikipedia at all, not shared with the EN one.
